milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brown wool cluster center is at (5, 0, 5) spawn-relative. max_distance=5 ensures the player physically navigated toward the wool (targets are ~7 blocks from spawn, so player must move at least 2 blocks). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the wool to confirm visual identification.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch sign is at (-5, 0, -5) spawn-relative. max_distance=5 ensures the player walked to the birch area in the negative quadrant rather than detecting it from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures intentional visual confirmation of the sign.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a birch_boat results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must mine 5 birch_planks blocks from the scene (near the birch sign), place the crafting table from inventory, and craft the boat (5 birch planks in U-shape, Java Edition recipe). The crafted item is not in starting inventory so its presence confirms task completion.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a hay_block results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player has 9 wheat and a crafting table in starting inventory — exactly enough for one hay_block (3x3 wheat pattern). The hay_block is not in starting inventory so its presence confirms task completion.
